scope: Independent read-only review of the C620 selected-source Aspect metadata mapping and literal raw-body address scan. This review does not publish Drafts, change Current carriers, or establish runtime, projection, parser, or evaluator conformance.

requirements_checked: Every one of the 31 legacy Entity/Aspect paths maps to Aspects containment while retaining its non-Product labels.
Every selected metadata occurrence has a successor Draft with the exact next version and -draft identity.
Every successor metadata subject replaces its legacy Entity/Aspect value; no legacy Entity/Aspect metadata subject remains.
All 47 selected Product source Atoms map to Aspects <+ Product.
The map contains no Aspect//Product or Continuant target.

raw_body_reference_scan.method: For each of the 1,134 pinned selected sources, scan only content after the second frontmatter delimiter for the literal Entity/Aspect/ address prefix.
raw_body_reference_scan.conclusion: No additional body file is required for this exact-address migration; the consumer Draft bodies remain byte-preserved.

semantic_safety.generic_model_boundary: The map uses containment addresses only and does not introduce a concrete Aspect instance or Aspect//Product.
semantic_safety.continuant_boundary: No legacy Aspect subject is remapped to a Continuant; the named Framework Continuant remains a separate identity.
semantic_safety.notation_status: The review applies the user's settled containment notation and does not reopen it.

not_checked: The separately owned R2483 and C620 source Draft manifests
Projection regeneration, runtime, parser, graph-builder, SDK, workflow, fixture, or evaluator behavior
